steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I-Is it over? Did we manage to take care of them all?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hah... Hah... I'm beat...

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Hahaha! Not bad, girlie! You've got quite a few tricks up your sleeve. I sure am a big fan of casters!

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: Oh... Good... They aren't at fisticuffs any longer... Good, good, as long as everyone's fine...

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: C'mon, let's go, I'm in a good mood today! You can have a taste of some of my corn!

steps.name: Pioneer B
steps.text: Boss, you...

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Hmm? ...Wait, corn...
The laughter dies on the pioneer's lips as he raises his weapon at the team of four.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: *huff*... *huff*... Guess he remembered. And here I was thinking we could bury the hatchet.
Marcille raises her staff, strands of her hair rippling with magic.

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: Wha? Are we back at this already? Really? You were all battle buddies earlier, surely that's got to count for something, right?

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Hmph!

steps.name: Chilchuck & Senshi
steps.text: *huff*... *huff*...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Let's not go for magic right away, Marcille.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: We're all tired out from dealing with those things. There's no benefit in starting up another fight.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: We'll count down from three, lower our weapons, go back the way we came, and agree not to bother each other for the night. How about that?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: *cough* *cough* *cough*! How... about...... that...........?

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: Look, this guy's plenty sincere, alright? He's still offering even after he got a bomb chucked at him! Why not think his offer over?

steps.name: Pioneer B
steps.text: Our boys are tuckered out too, boss. I don't think fighting'll do us any good neither.

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: ...Fine. We'll get out of each other's hair for the night. Start counting.

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: Oh, yes, good!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Three, two, one!

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: Great... I can sleep soundly tonight...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Zzz...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Marcille? Marcille?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Zzz... Eh...?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Ah! Wh-What's going on now?!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Nothing.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: We were thinking of going to examine the bodies of those monsters earlier, and while we're at it...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Well, they looked like crabs to me, so they might taste like mimics.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Ahh, the chewiness of mimics... The more you chew it, the better the flavor gets.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Just don't use my lockpicks to scoop the meat out again.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: But they've got just the right shape for it!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: 'Bob's Gourmet Guide' says they're edible. Apparently they're delicious, as long as you can get through the shell! Don't you want to have a taste?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Absolutely not! Besides, if those villagers think we're sneaking back onto the battlefield for an ambush, we might get into another fight!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Those magic items flying all over the place were a pain to deal with, and there's still plenty of them out there! Not to mention, I'm still tired as—

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Munchmunchmunch... Huh?

steps.name: Pioneer B
steps.text: Munch... Huh?

steps.name: Pioneers and Laios's Party
steps.text: Huh???
The pioneers freeze in the middle of stuffing gloompincer legs into their mouths.
The only sound breaking the awkward silence is the crackling of the bonfire.
The sparks plik and plak amidst the flames.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Their pincers and limbs are stuffed full of flesh. No wonder they can support such heavy shells, as well as crush those magic items...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: So you cut them open from the belly, then pull back their shell... I see now. Looks like you prepare these things the same way you do mimics.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Then... Oooh...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: That smells amazing!

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Err... Wanna try some?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: ...Ggh.
Laios accepts the roasted meat, hesitates for a moment, then stuffs it into his mouth.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: IT'S DELICIOUS!

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Haha! It's all in the technique—*cough*! Gah...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Want a taste?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: ...Eh? It really is chewy! So fragrant too!

steps.name: Pioneer B
steps.text: Here, you guys have some as well.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Huh? For me? Thanks...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: It's roasted just right, so it hasn't lost any moisture. It even tastes just like mimic!

spans.text: It's roasted just right, so it hasn't lost any moisture. It even

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Alright, just eat already.

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Keep your lips shut once you're done, I've got a reputation to keep.

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Not a word about tonight, you hear?

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: (How is it you can be at each others' throats during the day, but be eating roast gloompincer together at night?! Guess there wasn't any need for me to rush over...)

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: Just going for a midnight tinkle, don't mind me, haha.

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Gosh darnit... C'mon over! You've given us meds, and I never forget a debt.

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: I'll let you guys off this time...

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: ...No, I can't! My barn! Why'd you guys blow up my barn?!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: We didn't! It was your magic items that attacked us! We had to counter their magic in self-defense!

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: M-Magic items? You mean my drones? They went nuts, weren't listening to me!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Huh?! But you still came out and attacked us!

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Because you were gonna steal our crops!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: You thought we were what—

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: Alright, alright, I've heard enough, I get what happened now! This was all one big misunderstanding!

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: Your drones went amok and bombed them by accident, they thought you were attacking them, then you thought they were trying to take your stuff using the Catastrophe as cover. One! Big! Misunderstanding!

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: So, how about we all shake hands and let bygones be bygones?

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: Forget it.

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: I'm... frozen...stiff...!

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: How...about....we...take...care...of...them...first...?

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: The drone relay's busted. I took a couple of courses on equipment maintenance, let me see if there's a way to fix it...

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: Gah! Anyone understand Originium circuits enough to come help me out? Everyone else handle the drones, get them to use up their bombs! I can't get anything done while I'm getting pelted by them!

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Go on then, we'll draw them away! Y'all work quick, ya hear!

steps.name: Pioneers
steps.text: Aaaaaaaahhhhhhhh––––

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Only thing I can do is help them remove the cover of this 'drone relay' quicker! Marcille, do you seriously have no way to handle those things? We can't ask Senshi to boil them all!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Uh... Umm... You'd need to give me time to learn a whole new system of magic...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Two more magic items flying over! Their flight speeds follow a pattern, and so do their patrol routes...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Each one carries a single bomb. Seems they fly away as soon as they drop it. Are they returning to their nest to replenish their stock?

steps.name: Laios & Marcille
steps.text: I can't think of anything on such short notice...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I've got a plan.

steps.name: Laios & Marcille
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: You think these items use some magic or other to know who's an enemy?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Well, they're not monsters. They don't have eyes, but since they can only throw a bomb once, they must have some way to tell friend from foe...?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Right, lad. I noticed earlier that they didn't pay any attention to a dead gloompincer.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: But then I saw a live one walk into one's range by accident. At first, no response, just like the dead one, but the moment the gloompincer raised its pincers, it got a bomb thrown at it.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: ...So they detect 'hostility'? The moment they sense it, they attack?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Oh, I've got a way to make them use up their bombs then!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I'll use a familiar to act as bait!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: A familiar?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Nothing too complex, I just need somethings full of hostility. I can use the gloompincers from earlier!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Get me some fruit from the forest to add in as well. Just pile them up while I think of what I want to make it look like...

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: Whoa whoa whoa, why're you cutting your hair all of a sudden?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hair's full of magical power. It's a good resource to have on hand.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Some flour, a handful of sugar, then knead in some butter... Now I just need a reference from real life.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hmm? Why're you looking at me like that?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Ah, I know what I want to use as the model!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: (Incants)...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Is it done? What's it look like? Let me see!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hey, isn't that me?!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Alright, time for a test run...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Left leg, right leg, left leg, right leg...

steps.name: Laios (Familiar Ver.)
steps.text: (Follows her commands)

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Okay, now run!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Good, let's get going!

steps.name: Pioneers
steps.text: AHHH! AHHHHHHHHH!!!!

steps.name: Pioneers
steps.text: Have you repaired it yet?! We're on our last legs here!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: We're here!
With a cheer, the pioneers turn their heads, but all they see is a strange figure running towards them at full speed, shouting in a stiff voice they don't recognize.

They have faced bloodthirsty wild beasts, survived Catastrophes big and small, and have been pelted by barrages of bombs from dozens of drones, but the sight is still enough to make the pioneers tremble in fear.
A man down on all fours, his long tongue rolling from his slobbering maw, his eyes bulging, screech as he crawls towards them at full speed!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Left leg! Right leg! Left leg! Right leg! Gah...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Why did I make it move that way?!?

steps.name: Laios (Familiar Ver.)
steps.text: (Follows her commands)

steps.name: Pioneers
steps.text: ...AHHHHHH! RUN FOR IT!!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Just get back as fast as you can! I'll distract the magic items! Don't stop here, head back to—

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Eh? Where'd everyone go?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: ...! The items must have noticed us!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I just need to lead them somewhere far from everyone else, then get them to throw all their bombs at the familiar!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: There's a field here, that should be okay...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Ah! I nearly forgot! They're not going to wait for my command to start attacking! They've already begun!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: No good, it's still too close; I'll get hit too. I need to find somewhere a bit further away!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: It's working! Marcille got the drones to head over there!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Now they just need to use up all their bombs! She's amazing!

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: Your 'magic' sure is real weir—I mean, great.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Argh! This is way more difficult than I imagined!

steps.name: Laios (Familiar Ver.)
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Wait, that noise...?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: They're about to fire?!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: This place... Would here be alright? Are we far enough? I need to keep running! It's all up to you now, Fami-Laios! I'm releasing control over you!

steps.name: Laios (Familiar Ver.)
steps.text: Gurgh...

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: Hey, I see her running out into the open! The drones are firing!

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: Hooray! She's done it!

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: That girlie sure is something... I always said I was a big fan of casters.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Yeah, Marcille's amazing.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Wait, I just remembered something...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Isn't that where the corn fields are?

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: I think you might be right...

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Hey, wait! MY... MY CORN FIELDS!!!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: They're about to fire!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I'll hide here—Whoa!
Explosions resound all around her, as expected.
But they are joined by the sweet scent of corn wafting through the air.
Marcille raises her head. It's like time itself has slowed, to the point that she can see every kernel fly through the sky, popping into fragrant popcorn of purest white under the bombardment.
The popcorn falls, floats, flutters like snow, landing on the tip of her nose.
She shudders.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: ...Huh?
Before she can do anything else, she is buried in an avalanche of fluffy white popcorn.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Gurgh...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Th-This is...
Popcorn!
I'm super strong! Even with a hundred... Err, wait, ninety-nine pieces of popcorn in front of me, I can eat them all!
Hyah! Bam! Pow!
Mount Popcorn, here I come!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Marcille! Marcille?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Marcille! Where are you? Can you hear us?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Oh no... We can't resurrect Marcille here!
Munchmunchmunch...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Hmm, that sounds familiar...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: That's the sound of Kay eating!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Munchmunchmunch... Oh! Mister Beard! It's you guys!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Why are you here, lass?!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I smelled something real tasty, so I ran over!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Come on, Mister Beard, Mister Short, Mister Blond! There's so much popcorn and frozen fruit to eat!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Munchmunchmunch... Oh yeah... munchmunchmunch... you're here too, Miss Blonde!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Don't...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Don't... eat... my... HAIR!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Pfweh! Sorry! I didn't mean to!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Marcille! You're alive!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... Just buried, not bombed.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Wow! This sticky stuff smells great!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Brr, it's all frozen! Real different from the popcorn!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: *sigh*... Sure is...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Want to try some?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Munchmunch... So frosty and sweet! Yummy!

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: Oh thank heavens, I'm glad you're alright!

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: Eh? ...Kay?!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Huh? Oh, I remember you!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: You were the one who came hunting with me! Did you get anything? I got looooots of stuff, but I ate it all!

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: Never mind. The guys before me were right. As long as I find you, it's mission complete—Hey, wait, what're you eating?! Spit that out!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Munchmunchmunch!

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: Don't just eat stuff off the ground! C'mon, spit it out already!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Munchmunchmunch... *gulp*!

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: AHHHH!!!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Don't worry, she's just eating popcorn.

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Heavens to Betsy! What doggone disaster! That corn was gonna go to market!

steps.name: Pioneer B
steps.text: Boss, don't say that, you're a Perro yourself...

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: How'm I supposed to sell any of this after it's been wrecked like this?!

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: I mean, you can sell popcorn. There's definitely people willing to buy it, out by the tents.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Throw in some butter and sugar, warm it up a bit while giving it a stir... Good, the smell's coming through! Not bad for a snack.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Pound the frozen fruit, stir in some batter from the familiar, shape it for presentation's sake... and you've got ice cream!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: There you have it, a sweet treat!

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Eh... Hmm... I guess this popcorn's good enough to sell...

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Not like I got much choice now...

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: I'll have a bite, then...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Not yet recovered?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Just breathed in a bit too much corn smell all at once.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: It's really delicious, though.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: The popcorn's warm and buttery, sweet and crisp...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: The ice cream's amazing, too. The fruit's so fresh, and with such a smooth texture...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Best of all, no monster meat.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Mhm. Lucky me.

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: *phew*... Glad that's all done and dusted.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Mmm... Heheh... Yummy, yummy ice cream...

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: *sigh* You sure know how to make people worry, kid.

steps.name: Ryan
steps.text: Hey, I'll be taking her home now. You guys don't start fighting once I'm gone, alright?

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Yeah, yeah, I know.
Ryan helps up Ceobe, fast asleep on the ground after eating her fill, and takes her to the nearby vehicle.
Its engine roars to life, and putters away into the distance.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hmm? Where's Kay gone?

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: You mean that other girlie? Ryan's taken her home.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Ryan? Why?

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Sounded like he was on some sort of mission for Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Wait, did you say Rhodes Island?! Ryan's from Rhodes Island?!

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Yeah. Why? What's got you in such a tizzy?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Laios!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Does that mean it's close by?

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: Uh, yeah, they're stopped a few kilometers away.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Ryan just left. If we start running now, we can catch up.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Let's go then! We can't afford to lose their trail again!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Pioneer A
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Pioneer B
steps.text: What're they on about?
